name: whisper-base-id
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Full-parameter Indonesian fine-tune of openai/whisper-base (74M), trained on 284.8 h of Common Voice 17 id, FLEURS id_id and large-v3-turbo-labelled YODAS2, 6000 steps with telephone/Opus/AAC/noise augmentation. Same tensor set and config.json as the base (6 encoder + 6 decoder layers, d_model 512); 0.073B params. A finetune, not a new base model and not a merged adapter. Recorded because the card prints base and finetune in one table on the same full test sets: WER drops 38.8 -> 15.0 on FLEURS id and 43.1 -> 14.5 on CV17 id, with CER falling in step. The card also publishes a short-context variant (encoder mel cut to the clip, whisper.cpp -ac) that costs 0.2 WER, plus whisper.cpp q8_0 latency on a Cortex-A53 (1870 ms, RTF 0.47) and RK3588 (198 ms, RTF 0.05). Scope caveat: Indonesian only, and output is lowercase with punctuation stripped, so it is not a drop-in multilingual replacement. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-01.
